games.startMessage: Three holo-mon on Mara's low rig, one of them a Ditto running a bad copy. Listen to each cry — the fake's reads a shade wrong — then stand by the liar and call it out.
games.winMessage: Blorp! The clean copy cracks and the disguise sloughs off. Mara's easy rig is beaten — sharp start.
games.loseMessage: That one rendered true. The Ditto holds its cover and Mara's meter blinks back to zero.

games.startMessage: Five in Dax's neon lineup, one forgery. The fake's cry carries a glitch under the pitch — read all five before you accuse the one you're sure of.
games.winMessage: Blorp! Dax's forgery destabilises and drops its skin. Nicely called.
games.loseMessage: Real signal. The Ditto giggles somewhere in the neon and the round resets.

games.startMessage: Seven holograms on Sera's top grid, one liar — the final hunt. The tells are faint up here. Trust the cry that slips, stand by it, and make the call.
games.winMessage: Blorp! The last disguise shatters across Sera's grid. You cleared the final hunt.
games.loseMessage: That was a true render. Sera's Ditto keeps its cover — the final hunt stands.
